Wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
Wallpaper.description: An AI generated phone wallpaper saved by the user.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this wallpaper.

prompt.description: The vibe or prompt description for this wallpaper.

base64Data.description: Base64 encoded image string or preview data.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated wallpaper (e.g. 9:16).

imageSize.description: Resolution size of the generated wallpaper (e.g. 1K, 2K, 4K).

modelUsed.description: Gemini model used to generate or remix this wallpaper.

isFavorite.description: Whether this wallpaper is marked as a favorite.

remixedFromId.description: Optional ID of the reference wallpaper remixed from.

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp. Submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().
